Lemma
1. ch2:2.13\group chapter-2 Source: gilbarg-trudinger:page-0037 Source: gilbarg-trudinger:page-0038 ↗ gt.thm2.12 Let $u$ be the Perron solution. If $\xi $ is regular and $\varphi $ is continuous at $\xi $, then $u(x)\to \varphi (\xi )$ as $x\to \xi $.
Proof

↗ gt.thm2.12 ↗ gt.lem2.13 \sketch For a barrier $w$ and any $\varepsilon >0$, choose $k$ so that $\varphi (\xi )\pm \varepsilon \pm kw$ are super- and subfunctions relative to $\varphi $. Then

\[ |u(x)-\varphi (\xi )|\leq \varepsilon +kw(x), \]

and $w(x)\to 0$ at $\xi $.

□
